$comment: Curated DrivingModelMetadata overrides keyed by model slug (lib/modelSlug.ts). Any field omitted here is inferred at runtime by lib/modelMetadata.ts and labelled as an estimate in the UI. Only add values you can verify (weights hashes, PR URLs, measured telemetry).

the-cool-peoples-model-v3.aliasNote: Same October 10, 2025 release as TCPmV3 — listed under its full name in the 2025 archive. Fleet route stats are reported under this name.

north-dakota-v2.aliasNote: Same April 29, 2024 release (openpilot commit 375978d40b, short name NDV2) — listed as 'North Dakota' in v10 manifests and 'North Dakota v2' in v20+ Model Manager.

light-speed-model-v1-1.aliasNote: Same October 29, 2026 release (openpilot commit c7cbe5de6a) — originally published as Light Speed Model v2 (LSMV2) before being renamed to Light Speed Model v1.1 (LSMV1.1) when Light Speed 2 dropped on November 04, 2026.
